disclosure: Curated explanatory labels and layout only. Action, variable, property, source-line, state-space, and transition data are regenerated from the pinned TLA+ modules, TLC configurations, checked evidence, and TLC DOT dumps.

member_local_restart.title: Independent member respawn
member_local_restart.description: Disable whole-appliance exit after required-role loss.

stop_without_fence.title: Stop before authority fence
stop_without_fence.description: Allow selected-Core replacement to stop before route and effect authority are fenced.

fallback_after_effect.title: Fallback after irreversible effect
fallback_after_effect.description: Allow LKG consumption after the pre-effect safety boundary.

caller_selected_scope.title: Payload-selected sibling scope
caller_selected_scope.description: Trust a caller-supplied target scope instead of deriving authority from the authenticated connection.

volume_before_release.title: Candidate writer before release
volume_before_release.description: Attach the candidate writer while the incumbent writer is still authoritative.

ark_core_appliance.title: Ark Core Appliance
ark_core_appliance.summary: One OCI/gVisor appliance starts its required internal roles in order, opens authority only on aggregate readiness, and recovers or terminalizes as one unit.
ark_core_appliance.question: When can one Ark safely admit work, recover, or replace its selected Core?
ark_core_appliance.property_description: Under weak fairness for deterministic lifecycle actions, every Off, Starting, Fenced, Crashed, or Recovery state eventually reaches Ready or Terminal.

aggregation.label: TLC states grouped by appliance mode

Off.label: Off
Off.description: No appliance task owns the scope. A cold boundary may read the durable selector exactly once.

Starting.label: Starting
Starting.description: The task owns its scope attachments while Engine, Persistence, Gateway, and Supervisor become ready in order.

Ready.label: Ready
Ready.description: Aggregate readiness, route generation, and effect ownership agree; admission may be open.

Fenced.label: Fenced
Fenced.description: Route and effect authority are closed before a selected-Core replacement stops the appliance.

Crashed.label: Crashed
Crashed.description: A required-role or activation failure has stopped the entire appliance and closed authority.

Recovery.label: Recovery
Recovery.description: Attachments and descendants have been reaped; policy chooses cached restart, one-use safe fallback, or terminal evidence.

Terminal.label: Terminal
Terminal.description: The bounded recovery policy has stopped with inspectable evidence instead of silently continuing.

ColdReadAndStartTask.description: At an Off boundary, cold-read the selected Core, cache that plan, and acquire the task's scope attachments.

StartEngine.description: Start Engine first; it is the appliance's internal PID 1.

StartPersistence.description: Start Persistence only after Engine is ready.

StartGateway.description: Start Gateway only after Engine and Persistence are ready.

StartSupervisor.description: Start Supervisor after Engine, Persistence, and Gateway are ready.

InstallAggregateReadiness.description: Bind ProcMan registration and route evidence to the current task epoch once every required role is ready.

OpenAdmission.description: Open admission and effect authority only when all aggregate readiness evidence agrees.

CreateOrdinaryDescendant.description: Create ordinary descendant work only while the appliance is Ready and admission is open.

CommitSuccessorSelection.description: Durably select the successor Core without changing the already cached running plan.

FenceForSelectionChange.description: Close route, admission, and effect authority before replacing the cached Core.

StopScopeForSelectionChange.description: Stop and release the fenced appliance so the next Off boundary can cold-read the successor.

RequiredRoleFailure.description: Any required-role loss exits the whole appliance, closes authority, and marks a crash failure.

MemberLocalRespawn.description: Deliberately unsafe control reachable only when whole-appliance failure handling is disabled; the checked production configuration makes it unreachable.

FailStartingRole.description: An activation-time role failure exits the whole appliance before admission.

MarkIrreversibleActivationEffect.description: Record the point after which an activation failure is no longer safe for automatic LKG fallback.

ReapCrashedScope.description: Reap descendants and release route, network, and volume ownership from the crashed epoch.

RestartCachedSelection.description: Restart the exact cached plan after a crash, even if a newer durable selector is pending.

ApplyAuthorizedLKG.description: Consume the one-use LKG permit only before admission and irreversible effects.

TerminalizeRecovery.description: Stop with inspectable terminal evidence when fallback is unsafe or retries are exhausted.

invariants.TypeOK: Every model variable remains inside its declared bounded domain.
invariants.InternalStartupOrder: Persistence follows Engine; Gateway follows Persistence; Supervisor follows Gateway.
invariants.SingleAuthoritativeVolumeWriter: At most one task epoch holds the authoritative volume.
invariants.LiveTaskOwnsOneScopeAttachment: A live task has exactly its own volume/network attachment and a cached Core.
invariants.AdmissionRequiresAggregateReadiness: Admission implies one live, fully ready, generation-aligned appliance.
invariants.EffectsRequireReadyAppliance: Effect authority implies Ready, admitted, all-role evidence for the current epoch.
invariants.RequiredRoleFailureStopsWholeAppliance: Required-role loss leaves no live member, admission, or effect owner behind.
invariants.FallbackIsPreAdmissionPreEffect: Consumed LKG fallback is proven to be before admission and irreversible effects.
invariants.TerminalStateIsInspectable: Terminal recovery always records inspectable evidence.

scenarios.title: Cold start to admission
scenarios.description: One cold read, ordered required roles, aggregate evidence, then authority.

scenarios.title: Whole-appliance crash recovery
scenarios.description: Required-role loss closes the whole scope; recovery reuses the cached plan.

scenarios.title: Selected-Core replacement
scenarios.description: A committed successor waits behind an explicit fence, stop, and next cold read.

scenarios.title: Pre-effect LKG fallback
scenarios.description: An activation failure can consume LKG only before admission or irreversible effects.

multi_ark.title: Multi-Ark Isolation
multi_ark.summary: Two roots and one authenticated child share host ProcMan supervision while retaining separate Core, task, volume, network, route, descendant, and failure state.
multi_ark.question: Can one scope start, fail, recover, or create descendants without gaining authority over a sibling?
multi_ark.property_description: Under weak fairness, every started scope reaches Ready and every crashed scope reaches Off independently of its siblings.

aggregation.label: TLC states grouped by RootA / RootB / ChildA phase tuple

StartRoot.description: Start one named root with only its expected Core, volume, and private network.

StartChildFromAuthenticatedParent.description: Start ChildA only through its authenticated RootA parent and assign ChildA's own attachments.

MarkScopeReady.description: Mark one scope Ready and create only that scope's local route.

CreateOrdinaryDescendant.description: Derive ordinary descendant authority from the authenticated caller scope, never a requested payload scope.

CrashScope.description: Crash one scope and remove only routes owned by that scope.

ReapScope.description: Release only the crashed scope's attachments, authority edges, routes, and descendants.

RestartReapedScope.description: Restart a reaped scope with its own next epoch and expected attachments.

invariants.TypeOK: Every per-scope variable remains inside its bounded domain.
invariants.EachScopeKeepsItsOwnAttachments: Every active scope has its expected private volume and network.
invariants.DistinctActiveScopeAttachments: Different active scopes never share a volume or private network.
invariants.OnlyScopeLocalRoutes: Every stable route begins and ends in the same scope.
invariants.NoCrossScopeAuthority: Ordinary descendant authority never crosses a scope boundary.
invariants.ChildParentIsFixed: ChildA can only be rooted beneath authenticated RootA.
invariants.RootsRemainIndependent: RootA and RootB remain independent root scopes.

structure_nodes.label: Host ProcMan
structure_nodes.description: Tracks scope selectors and lifecycle ownership without merging scope authority.

structure_nodes.label: Root A
structure_nodes.description: Independent root scope and authenticated parent of Child A.

structure_nodes.label: Root B
structure_nodes.description: Independent sibling root; no ordinary authority edge to Root A or Child A.

structure_nodes.label: Child A
structure_nodes.description: Separate child-root scope admitted only through authenticated Root A.

scenarios.title: Independent roots
scenarios.description: Root A and Root B may interleave startup while retaining distinct attachments.

scenarios.title: Authenticated child admission
scenarios.description: Root A becomes Ready before it can start Child A in Child A's own scope.

scenarios.title: Scope-local recovery
scenarios.description: A named scope crashes, reaps, and restarts without mutating sibling ownership.

host_cutover.title: Replacement-Host Cutover
host_cutover.summary: A candidate appliance validates privately before the incumbent is fenced, its writer is released, and production authority moves once.
host_cutover.question: Can a replacement host become authoritative without two writers or a private candidate leaking production authority?
host_cutover.property_description: Once an authorized cutover starts, weak fairness over fence, release, attach, readiness, and grant reaches candidate ProductionReady.

aggregation.label: Exact TLC state chain keyed by the action that produced each state

Init.label: Incumbent live
Init.description: The incumbent owns production writer, route, effects, and outer ingress.

ProvisionPrivateCandidate.label: Private start
ProvisionPrivateCandidate.description: The candidate starts without production writer, route, effects, or ingress.

ValidatePrivateCandidate.label: Private ready
ValidatePrivateCandidate.description: The candidate proves private readiness while remaining non-authoritative.

CompletePrivateCrashRebootRehearsal.label: Rehearsed
CompletePrivateCrashRebootRehearsal.description: The private candidate completes a crash/reboot rehearsal and returns Off.

BeginCutover.label: Cutover armed
BeginCutover.description: Cutover begins only after validation and rehearsal; incumbent authority is still intact.

FenceIncumbentAuthority.label: Incumbent fenced
FenceIncumbentAuthority.description: Route, effects, and outer ingress are removed before writer release.

ReleaseIncumbentWriter.label: Writer released
ReleaseIncumbentWriter.description: The fenced incumbent stops and releases the production writer lease.

AttachCandidateProductionWriter.label: Candidate attached
AttachCandidateProductionWriter.description: Only after release, the candidate starts on the production writer generation.

CandidateAggregateReady.label: Candidate ready
CandidateAggregateReady.description: The candidate proves aggregate readiness for the exact writer generation.

GrantCandidateAuthority.label: Authority moved
GrantCandidateAuthority.description: Route, effects, and outer ingress move together to the ready candidate.

RetireIncumbent.label: Incumbent retired
RetireIncumbent.description: The stopped incumbent retires after the candidate owns production authority.

ProvisionPrivateCandidate.description: Start the candidate on non-authoritative private resources.

ValidatePrivateCandidate.description: Mark private candidate validation without granting any production ownership.

CompletePrivateCrashRebootRehearsal.description: Prove a private crash/reboot cycle before cutover may begin.

BeginCutover.description: Arm the cutover only after private validation and rehearsal.

FenceIncumbentAuthority.description: Remove incumbent route, effect, and outer-ingress authority.

ReleaseIncumbentWriter.description: Release the incumbent's production writer after authority is fenced.

AttachCandidateProductionWriter.description: Attach the candidate writer only after the incumbent writer is gone.

CandidateAggregateReady.description: Prove candidate readiness for the exact attached writer generation.

GrantCandidateAuthority.description: Grant route, effect, and outer-ingress ownership together to the candidate.

RetireIncumbent.description: Retire the stopped incumbent after authority has moved.

invariants.TypeOK: Every host, phase, owner, and generation remains inside its bounded domain.
invariants.SingleAuthoritativeWriter: At most one production writer exists.
invariants.SingleRouteOwner: At most one production route owner exists.
invariants.SingleEffectOwner: At most one effect owner exists.
invariants.AuthorityOwnersAgree: Route, effect, and outer-ingress ownership move as one authority set.
invariants.AuthorityRequiresReadyWriter: Production authority requires a ready host on the exact writer generation.
invariants.PrivateCandidateHasNoProductionAuthority: Private validation never grants writer, route, effect, or ingress ownership.
invariants.CandidateAuthorityRequiresProof: Candidate authority requires validation, rehearsal, and exclusive writer ownership.
invariants.FencedIncumbentCannotRegainAuthority: After fencing begins, the incumbent cannot regain production authority.

scenarios.title: Validated single-writer cutover
scenarios.description: Private proof precedes fence, release, writer attach, readiness, and authority grant.
